cs.t: I have had an Asus N61JQ for the last couple of months. 300GB HD, 4GB RAM 1333mhz, Quad core i7 1.6ghz, and  ATI 5730 w/ 1GB. good solid build quality, noisy keyboard that didn't come w/ a backlight. decent system for $999. Plays well with linux as well. I bought one of their netbook models and that's been pretty solid as well.
cs.th: Ask HN: Which Non-Macbook notebook would you recommend?
